scope: Task-free maximum-permitted local LTD capacity probe; no learning, teaching, reward, or DAN events.

game.position_rule: position = 1 - time_us / approach_duration_us; visible from t=0 through the note time

intervention.weight_initialization: plastic_contact_rows divided by total selected-cohort plastic_contact_rows
intervention.out_of_window_selection: five KCs nearest the frozen control center; stable source order breaks ties
intervention.apply: Set only the selected condition's KC-to-MBON05 weights to exactly 20% of their original values before the note. Hold the resulting vector fixed throughout the note.

primary_endpoint: The first DOWN event's signed timing error relative to the note time, with no DOWN counted as failure.
stop_rule: Run this capacity-only comparison once. Do not train or begin the feedback-teacher stage in this run.
